thread:
anya: Heads up — noticed console sparklines slow across canary. LCP + interaction jank since yesterday's deploy. DevTools shows main chunk +1.3MB

anya: Digging — bundle analyzer shows a big new import: `@redwood/telemetry/full` pulled into client
mike: Wait we intentionally switched to telemetry-lite in last PR
anya: PR 6523 swapped `telemetry-lite` -> `telemetry` in packages/shared-analytics; build resolved to `full` at build-time
irene: Repro steps? link?
anya: Here's the script I ran:
```sh
# build canary
yarn build:console --env=canary
# inspect
npx source-map-explorer dist/main.js
```
anya: Graph shows `full` subtree ~1.1MB, parse time spike in profiler

nate: console telemetry package.json has no `browser` field, so bundler pulled node entry with extras
lisa: For a quick fix can we alias `@redwood/telemetry` -> `telemetry-lite` in webpack resolve in canary? :thinking_face:
sam: We could also revert the import in shared-analytics PR, but that's a rollback vs fix debate
mike: Alias config is safe for canary. I'll open a patch and test
anya: Also noticed main-thread parse time increased by ~45ms on 95th percentile for EU sessions

mike: Creating canary alias patch now — will post link
mike: PATCH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/6571

lisa: Can we add a bundle check to CI to catch full telemetry? add threshold gate
